title: The Manager executes every task itself; no agent branches, only main and arena-manager persist
problem: DEC-0017 made each Arena agent session a worker with a permanent arena/agent-NN branch and a task file on it. A proposed follow-up (DEC-0018, PR #299) added a task pool and a result pool on top of it. In practice the model created 15 extra branches and more than a dozen distribution issues, and required agent sessions the owner has to start and supervise. Only one task (TASK-0018) was ever worked on by an agent. The overhead outweighed the benefit.

options.summary: Remove the agent-branch / task-distribution concept entirely. The Manager executes every task directly and delivers each Slice as one PR from a short-lived branch that is deleted after merge. Persistent branches: main and arena-manager only. Task-distribution tooling (git-tasks, arena:task, AGENT_RULES, WORKFLOW, templates) is removed from main.
Keep DEC-0017 agent branches and task files.
Adopt the DEC-0018 task pool / result pool pipeline (PR #299).
